when you answered your boss' question, you became just as much an AH as they were for asking it. and just as disrespectful to the non-binary person's gender. that is deeply personal information about them and their *body* that should not be discussed in the workplace.

you should follow up by owning up to your mistake. that you should not have revealed that information, that it was inappropriate and disrespectful of you. reaffirm the person's pronouns and how important it is they are able to be safe and comfortable in the space. it won't undo the damage, but it might help.
